questions.q: About how many eggs can a queen bee lay in one day during peak season?
questions.fact: Up to about 2,000 eggs a day in peak season. She's the mother of almost every bee in the hive!

questions.q: What do nurse bees feed a larva to raise a new queen?
questions.fact: Royal jelly! All young larvae get some at first, but a future queen is fed royal jelly the whole time she's a larva.

questions.q: How many days does a queen take to grow from egg to adult?
questions.fact: Just 16 days. Worker bees take about 21 days and drones about 24.

questions.q: How long can a queen honeybee live?
questions.fact: Often 2 to 3 years, sometimes up to about 5. A summer worker bee lives only about 6 weeks.
